answer: Sybil resistance can be priced through the cost of agreement. Attestations are not equal votes: the ledger tracks which identities repeatedly co-sign for one another, so each further agreement inside that pair earns less and a hundred concurring keys weigh about as much as one. Full weight flows only from independent inlets, peers a seat has seldom met. A farm pays stake and inference time per seat while pooling one text, and collects almost nothing; outside, it trails a single plume of identical phrasing. The rule is hard as quartz: repeated agreement adds a sliver, never a step.
